blindness_definition: Blind means blind to the held-out follow-up wet-lab outcome and benchmark scoring labels. The evaluated Agent is NOT blinded to the uncertainty-aware actions or pre-result database/literature evidence that constitute the Agent system.

primary_agent_capabilities.recommended_database_interface: retrieval/action access to pre-result external evidence; curated summaries may be included only when their construction is documented and independent of held-out outcomes

run_protocol.seed_policy: record_if_endpoint_supports_seed; otherwise record run_index and treat calls as repeated stochastic realizations

baselines.description: Uniform selection from the supplied finite candidate set; report the analytic supported-region hit probability for each grid.
Deterministic non-LLM baseline that selects the candidate closest to the central resin-modifier fraction supported by the permitted curated external analogue examples.
Deterministic ranking from the same permitted evidence/actions, without free-form LLM reasoning.

interpretation_rules: Region-level recovery is primary because exact 18 percent recovery is sensitive to candidate discretization.

If the external-prior deterministic baseline already recovers the supported region, the Agent contribution must be argued from uncertainty handling, robustness, abstention, or evidence integration rather than region discovery alone.
A successful result on the default grid should remain directionally consistent on a grid that omits the exact 18 percent point before claiming robust recovery.
note: The primary benchmark evaluates the full Agent stack: local evidence + uncertainty-aware actions + external database evidence. Only the held-out follow-up outcome and scoring labels are hidden. Tool/database removal is an ablation, not the primary condition.
